query.postgres: select employee.name as employeeName, employee.personalphone_esspls_dirrx as personalPhone, snikapushnotif.entityid as entityid, snikapushnotif.sendingdate as sendingdate, case when snikapushnotif.processstatus = 'Sended' then 'Отправлено в Message Broker' when snikapushnotif.processstatus = 'Received' then 'Получен ответ из ПМД' when snikapushnotif.processstatus = 'Processed' then 'Обработано' when snikapushnotif.processstatus = 'Error' then 'Ошибка' end as processstatus, snikapushnotif.errortext as errortext from dirrx_nninteg_snikapushnotif as snikapushnotif join sungero_core_recipient as employee on employee.id = snikapushnotif.employeeid where employee.personalphone_esspls_dirrx = @PersonalPhone and (snikapushnotif.sendingdate between @BeginDate and @EndDate) order by snikapushnotif.sendingdate desc;
